title: Controlling of the F Region Plasma Structures by the E Region Conductance in the Auroral Ionosphere
summary:
Abstract 
                   At high latitudes, the E and F regions of the ionosphere are strongly coupled through nearly vertical magnetic field lines. To simultaneously and directly relate the E and F regions' plasma structures, we ran a coordinated conjunction campaign between Swarm satellites and Incoherent Scatter Radar in Tromsø, Norway, during a moderate geomagnetic storm in late March 2025. title: Magnetosphere‐Ionosphere Current Systems During Sawtooth Oscillations of October 2024 Geomagnetic Storm
summary:
Abstract 
                   The magnetosphere can undergo periodic loading and unloading of magnetic energy, a mode of activity known as sawtooth oscillations. title: Statistical Characteristics and Mechanisms of Digisonde Echo Disappearances During Geomagnetic Storms
summary:
Abstract
